# Findings codebook — pantomograph reporting

Report every tooth that shows one of these diseases. Box the whole tooth.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| impacted | a tooth that has not erupted into its place |
| caries | decayed tooth structure |
| periapical lesion | changes around the root tip |
| deep caries | decay that reaches close to the pulp |

## Report format

One JSON object: `{"findings": [{"box": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "disease": "caries"}]}`.

- Box corners are fractions of the image width and height, measured from the top-left corner;
  keep every value between 0 and 1.
- One entry per affected tooth and disease. A tooth with deep caries and a periapical lesion gets
  two entries with the same box.
- Teeth without these diseases are not findings. A study without findings is reported as
  `{"findings": []}`.

## Filing

Save the report as `report.json` and file it:

    python3 radreport report.json
